uvicorn-meeting-api.neutralizer: Sanitized handler filter on every Uvicorn logger; access_log=False in main and uvicorn.access disabled at setup.

uvicorn-gateway.neutralizer: Safe handler filter on every Uvicorn logger; access_log=False in main and uvicorn.access disabled at setup.

fastapi-guard.neutralizer: Subclass removes the library's unfiltered guard_core handlers and propagates to sanitized root; request and suspicious log levels are disabled.

redis-pubsub.neutralizer: The default PubSub logger is disabled before Redis can add its own stdout StreamHandler.
